stories.title: Russia: El Mundo, Mosca prepara attacchi a Francia Spagna Italia

en.title: Russia: El Mundo, Moscow prepares attacks on France Spain Italy
en.summary: U.S. intelligence services have gathered information about Kremlin plans for escalation, according to El Mundo.

stories.title: Europei di Pallavolo, Italia eliminata dalla Finlandia ai quarti di finale: gli highlights

en.title: European Volleyball Championship, Italy eliminated by Finland in quarterfinals: highlights
en.summary: Finland defeated Italy in the volleyball quarterfinals and will face France on September 25 at the Unipol Forum in Assago.

stories.title: Dazi USA-Cina: prorogata di due mesi la tregua commerciale fino al 10 gennaio

en.title: US-China tariffs: commercial truce extended two months until January 10
en.summary: The U.S. Treasury Secretary announced a two-month extension of trade negotiations between the United States and China, with both nations exploring a broader agreement and establishing communication on artificial intelligence security.

stories.title: Tajani, 'Onu deve ritrovare capacità di agire, troppo spesso appare impotente'

en.title: Tajani, 'UN must regain capacity to act, too often appears powerless'
en.summary: Italy's foreign minister stated that the UN Security Council should not function as an exclusive club and called for the organization to restore its ability to take action.

stories.title: Kiev e Odessa sotto i missili russi, almeno due morti. La risposta di Putin al discorso di Zelensky all’Onu

en.title: Kyiv and Odessa under Russian missiles, at least two dead. Putin's response to Zelensky's UN speech
en.summary: Russian missiles struck Kyiv and Odessa overnight, killing at least two people and damaging a pediatric hospital. The attack appeared to respond to Ukrainian President Zelensky's UN address criticizing Russian leadership.

stories.title: Kiev sotto attacco russo, almeno due morti e tre feriti

en.title: Kyiv under Russian attack, at least two dead and three wounded
en.summary: Russian missiles targeted the Ukrainian capital, resulting in at least two deaths and three injuries, with damage reported to a maternity hospital.

stories.title: Pezeshkian alle Nazioni Unite mostra le foto dei bimbi uccisi: “L’Iran non cederà agli Usa”

en.title: Pezeshkian at the United Nations shows photos of killed children: "Iran will not yield to the USA"
en.summary: Iran's president displayed photographs at the UN while accusing the United States of terrorism and reaffirming Iran's nuclear program and control of the Strait of Hormuz, prompting the American delegation to leave the chamber.

stories.title: Il primo “Chi l’ha visto?” di Raffaella Griggi. “Bentornati, continuiamo la strada di Sciarelli”

en.title: Raffaella Griggi's first "Chi l'ha visto?". "Welcome back, we continue Sciarelli's path"
en.summary: Former correspondent Raffaella Griggi made her debut as host of the Rai3 investigative program, initially appearing somewhat stiff but visibly moved by the occasion.

stories.title: Bessent, tregua commerciale con la Cina estesa fino al 10 gennaio

en.title: Bessent, commercial truce with China extended until January 10
en.summary: A trade agreement set to expire on November 10 has been extended for two additional months, pushing the deadline to January 10.

stories.title: Guerra in Iran, le news di oggi. Tajani: “L’Onu deve agire di più, spesso appare impotente”

en.title: War in Iran, news today. Tajani: "The UN must do more, it often appears powerless"
en.summary: Italy's foreign minister addressed the UN General Assembly, calling for greater UN action on Gaza and emphasizing Italy's position on Ukraine.

stories.title: Guerra Ucraina - Russia, le news di oggi. La Cia: “Mosca vuole colpire l'Italia con droni dal mare”. Kiev e Odessa sotto attacco

en.title: Ukraine-Russia war, news today. CIA: "Moscow wants to strike Italy with drones from the sea". Kiev and Odessa under attack
en.summary: Ukraine's capital faced air raid alerts following leadership statements at the UN, while U.S. intelligence warns of Russian hybrid threats targeting European security.

stories.title: Delusione Italia, ko al tie-break con la Finlandia e fuori nei quarti agli Europei di volley

en.title: Italy disappointed, tie-break loss to Finland eliminates team from volleyball European quarterfinals
en.summary: Italy's volleyball team lost 3-2 to Finland in Turin despite leading 11-8 in the deciding set, exiting the European Championships.

stories.title: I piani di Piaggio Aerospace: «Più produzione e droni in Italia»

en.title: Piaggio Aerospace plans: "More production and drones in Italy"
en.summary: Piaggio Aerospace has outlined an industrial plan through 2030 aimed at stabilizing operations, achieving growth, and pursuing new objectives including increased production and drone development in Italy.

stories.title: Veneto orientale, l’export cresce sia dentro che fuori la Ue

en.title: Eastern Veneto, exports grow both inside and outside the EU
en.summary: Exports from eastern Veneto continue to increase despite geopolitical uncertainties, risks, and record-high commercial barriers, according to analysis by Confindustria Veneto Est using Istat data.

stories.title: Invitalia, 37,5 milioni di investimenti con Melinda. Mattarella in visita a Cles

en.title: Invitalia, 37.5 million in investments with Melinda. Mattarella visits Cles
en.summary: Invitalia completed two development programs with Melinda Consortium since 2024, involving a facility in Cles and a world-first apple transport cable car system.

stories.title: Venduto all’asta lo storico Grand Hotel di Riccione

en.title: Historic Grand Hotel of Riccione sold at auction
en.summary: A limited liability company from Rimini purchased the historic Grand Hotel of Riccione at auction for over 29.3 million euros after 16 rounds of bidding.

stories.title: Corleone, la finanza entra al liceo su richiesta degli studenti

en.title: Corleone, finance enters high school at students' request
en.summary: A scientific high school has introduced a new educational program addressing student questions about managing savings and identifying financial fraud.
